title: C:\fakepath\ (He Chose It)
summary: The browser's file picker is the readymade's act of choosing: any file you pick gets a museum cartel built from its metadata alone, never opened, with provenance replaced by the spec-mandated fake path C:\fakepath\.
mechanism: Native <input type=file> change event reading only File.name/size/type/lastModified (no FileReader, no network) plus input.value, which the HTML Standard forces to report 'C:\fakepath\' + filename on every OS.
references: The Blind Man, no. 2, 'The Richard Mutt Case' (May 1917)
HTML Standard, file input value 'C:\fakepath\' rule (WHATWG)
